uniques.name: Wanderer's Soles
uniques.flavor: They have walked further than you ever will.

uniques.name: Grandfather's Cleaver
uniques.flavor: He swore it could split a boar in two. It can.

uniques.name: Whisperwind
uniques.flavor: The arrow arrives before the sound.

uniques.name: Band of the Boar
uniques.flavor: Stubborn, thick-skinned, and proud of it.

uniques.name: Crown of the Hollow King
uniques.flavor: The king is gone. The crown still rules.

uniques.name: Malgrave's Phylactery
uniques.flavor: Something inside it is still screaming.

uniques.name: Bramble Loop
uniques.flavor: Found by a little girl in the forest. It never quite stops growing.

uniques.name: Spidersilk Wraps
uniques.flavor: Woven in the dark beneath the ridge.

uniques.name: Ironclaw Carapace
uniques.flavor: Cut from the old crab's own shell. It still smells of the sea.

uniques.name: Tidebreaker Gauntlets
uniques.flavor: Ironclaw's pincers, hammered flat. They still want to grab things.

uniques.name: Crown of the Deep
uniques.flavor: Barnacles and old iron, pulled from the grotto's deepest pool.

uniques.name: Emberpalm
uniques.flavor: The old master's wraps never cooled.
